messages:
frank: Opening coordination for migration `mig_2026_10_userflags_circuit`. Window 03:00-04:30 PST. Adds nullable `user_flags` jsonb and a circuit-breaker style backfill so we can safely stop/reduce impact if DB pressure rises. Canary holdpoint at 03:15.

deploybot: Migration queued: mig_202610 (id: mig-202610). Canary holdpoint scheduled at 03:15. Controls: `/deploy abort 1766667000`, `/deploy continue 1766667000`, `/deploy update 1766667000 --param=value`.

zoe: Proposal after last runs: batch_size=4200, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=3, min_batch=800. Circuit-breaker rules: if db_cpu > 75% OR lock_wait_avg > 250ms OR replica_lag > 40s for 3m -> enter throttle-only mode (reduce batch by 60% and rps cap); if any metric stays bad for 8m -> escalate to abort. Also expose `POST /ops/backfill/circuit` to force-open/close.

migbot: Note: auto-checkpoints enabled. Progress written to `backfill_progress` every batch commit. Resume safe.

ops: Endpoints created and tokens provisioned to oncall: `POST /ops/backfill/circuit`, `POST /ops/queue/ratecap`, `POST /ops/replica/hold`. Short-lived tokens in vault.

frank: Runbook SQL & run loop for incident bundle: 

```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;

-- resumable batched update (psql pseudocode)
WITH batch AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 4200
)
UPDATE users u SET user_flags = '{"flags":[]}' FROM batch b WHERE u.id = b.id;
-- pause: SELECT pg_sleep(0.12 + random() * 0.12);
-- persist checkpoint: INSERT INTO backfill_progress(name,last_id) ...
```

Also include COPY notes for tenants >4M rows. We'll mark them in `tenant_backfill_policy` prior to start.

zoe: Soft-verify plan: after canary run sample 1500 rows across several shards: `./tools/sample_check --n=1500 --shards=3` and run a small suite of read-probes `./scripts/read_smoke.sh`. If any mismatch or p95 reg > threshold -> abort.

frank: Rollback/abort triggers (agree):
- p95 latency increase > 9% sustained for 10m
- error rate +2.5% absolute for 5m
- deadlocks >= 4 in 10m
- replication lag > 45s for 6m
- circuit stayed open for >8m without recovery
On abort: `/deploy abort 1766667000`, stop workers, snapshot `backfill_progress`, set `migration_state='aborted'` in metadata, notify frontend/product. Revert plan: run a safe schema-undo (drop column) only after product signoff, otherwise mark as paused and resume later. Owner for revert: frank.

deploybot: Config applied for 1766667000: batch_size=4200, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=3, min_batch=800, circuit_breaker=enabled. Start 03:00, canary 03:15.

migbot: Canary holdpoint reached at 03:15. Awaiting soft-verify results.

zoe: Soft-verify running now from canary host: `./tools/sample_check --n=1500 --shards=3`. Posting in ~90s.

(tools): sample_check output: 1500 samples, 0 mismatches, schema OK. Read probes: no regressions. Metrics: p95 stable in 5m window.

frank: `/deploy continue 1766667000` 44d proceeding with staged ramp: concurrency 3 -> 8 over 15m, increase workers in waves. Monitoring pinned: p95, error-rate, replica-lag, db_cpu, lock-wait.

~03:30 ops: Observed replica lag spike to 52s for ~3m. Operator action: invoked `POST /ops/queue/ratecap {"rps":5}` and toggled circuit to throttle-only mode for 10m. Logged event to /var/backfill/mig_202610/events.log. No abort yet.

zoe: After throttle-only step, replica lag recovered to 10s within 4m. We kept the job running but with reduced batch_size=1680 and increased sleep to 220ms. Monitoring continues.

frank: Quick note: auto-checkpoint allowed resuming smoothly; no duplicate work. Progress at 03:45: ~6% completed, estimated remaining 142M rows.

~03:50 ops: Another short CPU bump triggered circuit for a 2m window, but it cleared quickly. We did not see deadlocks. Decided to continue with conservative ramp.

frank: By 04:05 small/medium tenants done; big-tenant COPYs are running in parallel and expected to finish by ~04:20. No abort performed. Persisted progress to `/var/backfill/mig_202610/progress.json`.

zoe: Post-run actions: uploaded perf diffs and event logs; opened retro ticket to tune circuit thresholds and consider auto-escalation to pause non-critical tenants earlier. Will draft release note for #release-notes with rollback guidance and feature-flag timeline.

frank: Thanks everyone. Saving run artifacts and closing thread. :tada:
